name: scope

findings.message: Two additions go beyond the stated requirement (propagate `always_run:` from the extending template): (a) a fallback that searches `.zbuild/templates/` for the base template file when it is not found in `config/templates/`, and (b) a new awk block that extracts arbitrary additional top-level stage-definition blocks from the per-repo file and appends them to the merge output. Both are needed to make the SPEC-5 test scenario work (the fixture puts both the base and extending template in `.zbuild/templates/`, and the per-repo adds a `persist:` block), but they introduce new template-resolution capabilities—per-repo templates as bases, per-repo stage blocks forwarded into the merge—not named in the issue, ADR amendment, or planned scope description.

The newly added `## Enforced by` section includes the bullet `§Memory store is never reclaimed — tests/unit/cleanup-new-reclaimers-test.sh SPEC-4`; that statement and test reference concern memory-store reclamation from a different issue domain and are unrelated to the orchestrator backend retirement (#1801). The other three bullets in the section are directly on-topic.

reason: the scope lens found no high or critical problem the change introduced that fails it
